hits.title: Tokenisation is not in APX
hits.abstract_snippet: In this paper, we prove that, unless P=NP, no polynomial-time algorithm can find a tokeniser whose objective is within any constant factor of the optimum, meaning that tokenisation is not in the APX complexity class. hits.title: Can image generation help visual reasoning? An empirical study
hits.abstract_snippet: Language models think in words; then multimodal models might think in images. We test whether a generated helper improves the answer to a visual question. A model describes the helper it needs and then answers using the original and generated images together. hits.title: Attack Policy Selection can Mislead Monitor Evaluators
hits.abstract_snippet: AI monitors, classifiers that flag dangerous behaviour by AI agents, are often evaluated against transcripts generated by attack policies acting as proxies for dangerous behaviour in deployment. We evaluate an ex-production OpenAI monitor as a case study and find that measured false negative rate is highly sensitive to both the method used to generate attack policies and the level of optimisation

hits.title: Diverse Alternative Reasoning Traces for Hard Math Problems
hits.abstract_snippet: Post-training large language models (LLMs) for mathematical reasoning often relies on accepted traces whose final answers pass a verifier. For hard math problems, however, such traces can be rare under independent Monte Carlo (MC) sampling.
